scheduled.title: Intercom — Main Office
scheduled.body: Reminder to all students and staff: today's pep rally will begin ten minutes early. Teachers, please have your classes in the gym by 1:50. Go Bulldogs.

toast.title: Intercom
toast.body: Ten minutes early. You had ten minutes planned. Mastery −2.5.

roomTemp.label: Locked In
roomTemp.line: Right after lunch and every pencil is moving. Enjoy it.

roomTemp.label: Restless
roomTemp.line: Post-lunch static. Nothing has happened yet.

roomTemp.label: Suspiciously Quiet
roomTemp.line: This period is never this quiet. Somebody is getting away with something.

roomTemp.label: Feral
roomTemp.line: It is fifth period and you have lost the room. It is recoverable. It will cost four minutes.

roomTempReading.blindHint: Something in that corner is behind furniture.

reportLines.label: Mastery
tiers: You covered it. That is not the same thing.

reportLines.label: Fidelity
tiers: The objective board still says Tuesday.

reportLines.label: Rapport
tiers: They will give you the benefit of the doubt tomorrow.

reportLines.label: Bandwidth left
tiers: You have one more period in you.
You have one more period and no planning hour.
It is 1:45 p.m. and it shows.

closingLines.sawCurveball: You do not think about the lesson on the drive home. You think about a phone screen at minimum brightness.
closingLines.heavyScanning: You used Withitness {uses} times in 47 minutes. That is roughly once every three minutes. That is a lot.
closingLines.missedSeveral: {missed} things happened in this room that you never saw. That is a normal number. That is the part nobody tells you.
closingLines.quiet: Nothing much happened. Post-lunch and quiet. Bank that one.
closingLines.neverChecked: You never once checked whether they had it. You taught the whole period into a room you were assuming things about.
closingLines.rushed: You moved on {rushed} times before they were ready. Every one of those was a decision made by the clock.
closingLines.reteach: You backed up and said it a different way {reteaches} times. That is the only part of this the data will never see.
closingLines.unfinished: You got {done} of {total} beats out. The pacing guide has an opinion about that and it is wrong.
closingLines.greenIsland: {name} understood it before you finished explaining it and did not tell anybody.
